def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    face_value = 100
    coupon_rate = 0.08
    coupon_payment = face_value * coupon_rate
    spot_rates = [0.07, 0.08, 0.09]

    # Discount each annual cash flow using its corresponding spot rate
    bond_price = sum(
        coupon_payment / (1 + spot_rates[year - 1]) ** year
        for year in range(1, 4)
    )
    bond_price += face_value / (1 + spot_rates[2]) ** 3

    # Return the price rounded to three decimal places
    return round(bond_price, 3)
